name: Confetti Triangles
description: Small triangles scattered in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

code.style: --rule: ( background: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 1 / 10000px; transform: scale(1.5) rotate(45deg); } background-size: 150px 150px; background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @doodle( @grid: 4 / 100%; :after { content: ''; @size: 100%; position: absolute; background: @doodle( @grid: @r(1,4) / 100%; @shape: triangle; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform: rotate(@p(0, 180deg)) scale(.8); ); } ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
